note: Clay County GA parcels are published only through the Schneider qPublic viewer (qpublic.net/ga/clay), a proprietary web app with no public ArcGIS REST, MapServer or FeatureServer URL found. The county maps page offers only a static PDF parcel map. ArcGIS Online/Hub searches for Clay County GA parcels returned nothing (only Clayton County GA and Clay County FL/MO/AL). Neighbouring host patterns (Capture CAMA, PowerSouth AL) do not cover Georgia.
